requested_scope.statement: All three operating Hyderabad Metro corridors: Red Miyapur to LB Nagar, Blue Nagole to Raidurg, Green JBS Parade Ground to MG Bus Station (selected roads within ~200 m of the alignment, up to ~500 m where justified).

achieved_scope.statement: Frozen road inventory for ONE corridor package only: Blue Line Uppal to Tarnaka (stations Uppal, Stadium, NGRI, Habsiguda, Tarnaka). Red and Green corridors and the rest of Blue (Nagole to Uppal, Tarnaka to Raidurg) have NO selected roads: no road data was acquired (Overpass/Geofabrik blocked by environment network policy).

requested_network_denominators.note: null = unknown. Never 0 or 100 percent. Package-only totals are given separately under achieved_package_totals.

achieved_package_totals.non_routable_note: Non-routable boundary roads are drivable OSM roads weakly connected to the strongly connected routable core (they leave or enter the acquired data); implemented as roads, never used for deliveries or routes, not field verified.

length_convention: Physical road length = sum of OSM centreline lengths of the selected RoadEdges (rounded to 0.01 m), each two-way road counted once, one-way carriageways counted once each. Directed edges are never double counted. Frontage lengths are per street side (left/right of the edge forward direction), so frontage_total = 2 x road total.
